scripts.check: test -e node_modules || ln -s ../nook-web-app/node_modules node_modules; node ../nook-web-app/scripts/generate-i18n-keys.mjs --check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit

scripts.lint: cd .. && nook-web-app/node_modules/.bin/eslint --config eslint.config.js nook-web-extension nook-web-shared/src/extension nook-web-shared/src/components nook-web-shared/src/generated
